listing.title: Plant Collector Tote Bag | Excellent Self Control Tropical Leaves
listing.description:
Wear your plant-collecting truth with this witty canvas tote: 'Just One More Plant, I Have Excellent Self Control.' Framed by beautifully illustrated tropical leaves, it's the perfect bag for plant enthusiasts who've lost count of their collection. Roomy enough for nursery finds, market trips, or everyday hauling. Connects you with the plant-parent community—whether you're hunting rare varieties or admiring fellow collectors' greenery. Makes a thoughtful gift for plant lovers, balcony gardeners, or anyone who's ever sworn they had self-control and then came home with another plant. Durable, canvas construction designed for years of plant-hunting adventures.
